'''News24''' is a 24-hour Hindi [[News broadcasting|news television channel]] owned by B.A.G. Films and Media Limited. It has been launched in 2007 and it is [[free-to-air]] channel in India. News 24 changed its logo with a new design.<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://www.news24online.com/p/about-us/ | title=Latest News, Bollywood News, India News, World News Today, News Headlines, Breaking News Headlines, News Today |access-date=4 April 2020}}</ref>

Promoted by Anurradha Prasad, sister of former Union Minister [[Ravi Shankar Prasad]], along with her husband, [[Indian National Congress]] politician [[Rajeev Shukla]]. Anuradha Prasad is the chairperson and managing director of B.A.G. Films and Media Limited.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Vivek |first1=G. S. |title=Everyone's Best Friend |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/magazine/profile/story/20130506-profile-of-rajeev-shukla-763331-2013-05-01 |access-date=27 December 2020 |work=India Today |date=1 May 2013 |language=en}}</ref> B.A.G. Films and Media was founded on 22 January 1993.<ref>{{Cite web |title=BAGFILMS.IN {{!}} B.A.G. Films & Media Ltd. Company Profile & Executives – WSJ |url=https://www.wsj.com/market-data/quotes/IN/XNSE/BAGFILMS/company-people#:~:text=The%20company%20was%20founded%20by,is%20headquartered%20in%20Noida,%20India. |access-date=2024-05-23 |website=The Wall Street Journal}}</ref>

News 24 is a media conglomerate with diversified interests in production, television broadcasting, radio, new media ventures and education.
